title: Rabbi Berechyah bar Yitzchak
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Midrash Shmuel 20:7. Hyman cites the statement in the work abbreviated דו״ר, 2:20, as Rabbi Berechyah in the name of Rabbi Yitzchak. It also appears in Tosafot, Sotah 42b, under Me'ah; Hyman says that there too the attribution should read “in the name of Rabbi Yitzchak.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The correction changes an apparent father-son attribution into a report in Yitzchak’s name.

The supplied abbreviation דו״ר naturally suggests Devarim Rabbah, but the consulted Devarim Rabbah 2:20 differs from the quoted statement. The abbreviation is therefore retained without silently identifying the supplied citation with another work. The consulted Ruth Rabbah 2:20 has Berechyah reporting in Yitzchak’s name. The separately routed Midrash Shmuel chapter 20 paragraph and Tosafot Sotah instead have bar/berabbi Yitzchak. Hyman’s instruction that the attribution should read “in the name of Rabbi Yitzchak” remains his proposed correction, not a repair accepted into the Hebrew or proof about filiation. The old note about the correction is preserved as a description of that proposal. The literal Midrash Shmuel 20:7 request was unavailable; the routed paragraph does not certify the printed locator.
